referenceFunction.generalComment: The dataset can be used for a lithium-ion battery, e.g. for mechanical drive of an electrical vehicle. The battery pack (containing 14 singel cells) provides an electric power of 2.1 kWh and a voltage of 48 V. Data are based on measurements. For infrastructure, the ecoinvent dataset "electronic component production plant" is accounted. Transportation: the single cell are transported by ship from Peking to Amsterdam and by lorry within Europe (1000 km).; UUID: 960ee8d7-acb1-382b-b05d-4b4070cba823
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset incudes the production of a lithium ion battery pack.14 single cells, a steel box, a battery management system and cables are taken into acount. Further, the dataset includes the electric current for battery activating and testing. For infrastructure, the ecoinvent dataset "electronic component production plant" is accounted. Transportation: the single cells are transported by ship from Peking to Amsterdam and by lorry within Europe (1000 km).

technology.text: This dataset includes a method of producing a lithium ion battery. During the charge process, lithium ion move from the cathode (LiMn2O4) into the electrolyte (LiPF6 in ethylenecarbonate) through the micropores of the seperator into the anode (lithium ion intercalation). During the discharge of the battery the Li+-ions move back into the cathode. The battery pack (containing 14 singel cells) provides an electric power of 2.1 kWh and a voltage of 48V. Data are based measurements. The battery pack contains a battery management system.
